name: hysacomp
description: Butter: source-dated HYSA comparisons with clear baseline-relative returns. Local browser and CLI tools for people and AI agents.

paragraphs: Compare what your cash earns, how it can leave, and which conditions need checking. Open Butter · Download the offline bundle · GitHub

Butter starts with no scenario. Try the optional fictional working-person example, enter your own cash flows, or import a YAML, JSON or XML file. Your scenario stays in browser memory until you save it. Reloading clears it. No bank login, analytics, API key or cloud account is needed.

Version 3.2.0, build 2026-10-09, scenario/bank schemas 3.2. The bundled bank research was checked 2026-10-09. Retrieval dates, provider effective dates, source dates and freshness are visible separately; variable rates can change.
features: Compare after-tax interest, bonuses, fees and gain over a mandatory baseline.
Model dated salary, expenses, one-time payments and withdrawals using daily balances.
Inspect legal-bank identity, related-brand insurance, transfer limits, wires, holds,
Stress-test a $50k, $100k, $250k, $500k or custom exit. Unknown limits stay unknown.
Export raw JSON, CSV, an SVG chart, scenario XML and bank XML.
